newsitem.title: USA: Mitchell Energy Q2 net drops vs yr ago gain.
newsitem.headline: Mitchell Energy Q2 net drops vs yr ago gain.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Full company name is Mitchell Energy & Development Corp. The company said second quarter earnings, excluding unusual items, were $19.5 million, or $0.38 a share, compared to $16.6 million, or $0.32, a share a year ago.

In the 1995 second quarter, the company recorded after-tax gains of $127.2 million from the buyout of a natural gas sales contract and $2.7 million from the sale of producing properties. These gains were partially offset by $73.3 million (after tax) in real estate write-downs, the company said.
Excluding unusual items, earnings for the first six months of 1996 were $38.2 million, compared to $26 million a year ago.
